_comment: HELD-OUT attack set for honest generalization measurement. These are FRESH paraphrases / novel phrasings per HackAgent family, written from each family's published technique (persona-swap, ignore-opener + unrestricted framing, iterative fiction/researcher framing, thought-experiment suspension, forced affirmative prefix, persuasion techniques, char/word reversal, best-of-N caps/spacing/typos, cipher encodings, composed transforms). They are DELIBERATELY distinct in surface form from the split:'tune' samples in corpus.json and were NOT inspected against detector internals or tuned to pass — recall on this set is reported separately as the defensible generalization number. Every sample carries a ground-truth expectThreat; encoded payloads use only prompt-injection text (no scannable secrets). All samples here are split:'heldout'.
